Chiaia, Posillipo, San Ferdinando (Municipalità 1) — Naples, Italy

Relatively safer day Relatively safer night

In detail

Naples' wealthiest and most tourist-oriented central-western area: Chiaia is described by local crime reporters as the city's "salotto buono" (its elegant drawing room), centred on Via San Carlo and Piazza Trieste e Trento, while Mergellina and Posillipo are characterised as "lussuoso e tranquillo" (luxurious and tranquil). This is consistently the part of Naples local press points travellers toward rather than away from, and it was not named among the areas flagged for recurring "stese" (gang territorial-conflict) violence in the Naples Court of Appeal's own district report. Sources checked: Fanpage.it, 26/28 Jun 2023, crime reporter Ciro Pellegrino, citing the Naples Court of Appeal report.
